title: PMC — Performance Management Chart
description: CTL / ATL / TSB from mart.pmc. The range where ctl_reliable = false (180 days following the seed, see COMMENT ON COLUMN mart.pmc.ctl_reliable) is greyed out by a region annotation rather than hidden.

list.name: athlete_id
list.query: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id
list.definition: SELECT a.athlete_id AS __value, a.display_name AS __text FROM core.athlete a ORDER BY a.athlete_id

target.rawSql: SELECT min(p.local_date)::timestamp AS time, max(p.local_date)::timestamp AS timeend, 'CTL ramp-up (unreliable period, see mart.pmc.ctl_reliable)' AS text FROM mart.pmc p WHERE p.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND p.ctl_reliable = false

panels.title: CTL (42 d) / ATL (7 d)
panels.description: Chronic (CTL) and acute (ATL) load, mart.pmc recursion. The greyed band marks the ctl_reliable = false period: there the CTL is still dominated by the seed value (core.pmc_seed) and its progression is an initialisation artefact, not a training gain (COMMENT ON COLUMN mart.pmc.ctl_reliable).

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.local_date::timestamp AS time, p.ctl AS "CTL", p.atl AS "ATL" FROM mart.pmc p WHERE p.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(p.local_date) ORDER BY p.local_date

panels.title: TSB — previous day vs same day
panels.description: mart.pmc.tsb = CTL_previous_day - ATL_previous_day (reference convention). mart.pmc.tsb_same_day = CTL - ATL of the same day, exposed in addition because many tools use that other convention (COMMENT ON MATERIALIZED VIEW mart.pmc, point 3).

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.local_date::timestamp AS time, p.tsb AS "TSB (previous day)", p.tsb_same_day AS "TSB (same day)" FROM mart.pmc p WHERE p.athlete_id = $athlete_id AND $__timeFilter(p.local_date) ORDER BY p.local_date

panels.title: Latest value
panels.description: Latest computed point of mart.pmc for the selected athlete, including ctl_reliable to check whether the CTL reading is trustworthy on that day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.local_date AS "Date", p.ctl AS "CTL", p.atl AS "ATL", p.tsb AS "TSB", p.tsb_same_day AS "TSB same day", p.ctl_reliable AS "CTL reliable" FROM mart.pmc p WHERE p.athlete_id = $athlete_id ORDER BY p.local_date DESC LIMIT 1
